claim_class: 3 claims, no bijection: forward MI projection onto the 190,201 retained coordinates (identity map, objective Equal) + two reverse IntervalLift halves (integer and LP) reconstructing the 200 eliminated loads and z; plus one FiberStrictness point refutation (inclusion_claim 2) proving strict projected LP strengthening.

Reverse claims: one IntervalLift each (3 lower + 2 upper interval facts, 6 premises) whose body proves the 2,303 source rows and emits a 190,402-entry reconstruction map (200 eliminated loads as 950-term sums of retained assignment coordinates, z as the fresh interval variable; :164-168). Body 374 steps (integer half, incl. 3 EqPair + 3 Int chains for z) and 373 steps (LP half).

Integer half carries 763,308 checks vs 573,107 for the LP half; the 190,200 VarInt checks and the Cases/EqPair integrality steps are the only content that differs, yet both halves reserialize the identical 13,446,666 B map (:207-209).

Third claim: FiberStrictness inclusion_claim=2 with a complete 190,402-coordinate source point (770,230 B of exact rationals) and an Absurd refutation whose single Lin step has 952 terms; preparation.json fiber_contradiction 159/25. statistics.bijections 0, points 1.

agent_manual_work: Whole-file MPS interpretation and emission by hand: 10 eval cells / ~40,476 chars of eval code (digest transcript census); exact parser over 955,223 lines with fail-closed section/bound assertions, and a hand-written author of the target file (decimal_exact writer + round-trip assert all(num(decimal_exact(v))==v), digest eval 'Writing exact reformulation and change manifest').

Wrote a second, independent artifact auditor (output/verify.py, 160 lines) containing its own MPS parser, check_point evaluator, and a full target reconstruction (expected_rows/rhs/cols at :80-96, equality assert at :132) - the only mechanical check the target file was ever subjected to.

Structural census by hand: 950 one-hot rows x 200, 190,000 assignment binaries, 200 load definitions, exact equality of all 190,000 weights, the 4 special y, all 16 selector patterns, duplicate row/column signature scans, and union-find connectivity over 190,402 variables (hypothesis_checks.json).

Manual witness design for both smoke points (integer witness and the 1/100 fractional variant that violates exactly one tightened row), plus a budget-essential counterpoint integral point whose sole violation is the budget row.
preparer_helpers: tools/prepare_test10.py is 247 lines and imports 9 helpers from 7 sibling preparers: parse_mps/row_ref (prepare_affine:20,77), expression/plus/mul/expr_json/row_fact/sha (prepare_test40:72-89), substitute (prepare_test57:11), SparseBuilder (prepare_test70:14), fact/box/exact (prepare_test54:16-33), extend (prepare_test23:15), round_fact (prepare_test37:18).

Hand-rolled exact sparse algebra: expression -> (Fraction constant, {var index: Fraction}), plus/mul/substitute, exact() to collapse trivial obligations to the string 'Exact', and expr_json as the wire encoder {'constant','terms':[[i,'p/q']]}.

Case-local rule constructors: cases() (2-branch Cases with VarInt split and Witness ends, :20-32) and selector_fact() (:35-52) which turns a row fact into forced bound facts; round_fact() then converts a Le bounding fact plus a 950-term Int fact into a rounded integer fact.

Per-variable bookkeeping as Python dicts keyed by canonical index (assignment/weights/loads/groups/costs/charges, ~190k entries) re-checked exactly against the agent's manifest: 951 prefix sums (:83-84), all 170 M values and F_j (:97,115), and the 170-record thresholds list (:120: row, M, t, C, F_j).
friction: request.json is 8,465,517 B and 8,465,115 B of it (99.995%) is three 190,201-pair projection tables of 2,821,705 B each; the map is exactly [[0,0]] + [[200+j,j] for j in 1..190200] - two arithmetic runs, 64 B as runs plus the 201 dropped source indices - so the caller pays ~132,000x the bytes the content needs.

claims[1] and claims[2] carry byte-identical 2,821,705 B projections and differ only in input_integers/output_integers, while claims[0]'s table is exactly their transpose; the whole 8,465,452 B claims array is then serialized twice, once in proof.rpa and once in request.json (:235).

The two reverse blocks each replay a byte-identical 13,446,666 B 190,402-entry Return map (200 load reconstructions of 950 terms each); the LP half differs only by the 190,200 VarInt checks it omits, so 13.4 MB of the 104.8 MB RPA is verbatim duplicated text.

Row-to-rule dispatch is hand-coded twice as 5-branch if/elif chains (:143-148 forward, :196-203 reverse) instead of being derived from the edit list, and the 170 tightening parameters (M, t, C, F_j) are recomputed in Python (:97-120) then cross-checked against the agent's manifest (:83-84,115) - with a third independent recomputation in verify.py:120-131.

The target model is never constructed or bound by the kernel: the analysis agent wrote reformulated.mps by hand, and the preparer (:143-149) plus a second parser in verify.py (:80-96,132) each rebuild the entire 2,105-row target from source plus edits to prove the delivered MPS is what the certificate claims.
